This appears to come from the AD/CVD "aluminum door thresholds" context, though the plain description matches a CBP ruling on adjustable aluminum door sills (thresholds). Door thresholds are classified as builders' joinery or as aluminum structures.

The candidates are:
- 7610.10.0030: aluminum doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors. This heading covers "Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors," and fits best.
- 7610.10.0020 is for doors, and 7610.10.0030 is for windows and their frames and thresholds, so I am not fully sure of the breakdown.

In the HTSUS, 7610.10.00 breaks down as:
- 7610.10.0010: Doors
- 7610.10.0020: Windows and their frames
- 7610.10.0030: Thresholds for doors

I am reasonably confident of this breakdown, so I pick 7610.10.0030.
